Trace, implement and test: 17.11.Find Closest

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
class Solution {
public:
    int findClosest(vector<string>& words, string word1, string word2) {
        const int inf = 1 << 29;
        int i = inf, j = -inf;
        int ans = inf;
        for (int k = 0; k < words.size(); ++k) {
            if (words[k] == word1) {
                i = k;
            } else if (words[k] == word2) {
                j = k;
            }
            ans = min(ans, abs(i - j));
        }
        return ans;
    }
};
